answers.core: This would greatly improve the usability of the new dynamic music systems. Without it I don't have much reason to use it, even though I want really want to due to its flexibility.
answers.workaround: The alternative is having to split every track into layers that you would have to manually adjust if its more complex than just adding/removing layers. The AudioStreamInteractive method would greatly simplify this but with the obvious phasing its not usable this way.

title: Modify AudioStreamInteractive cross-fade implementation to avoid phasing
